pairs: And the Lord said to me:
et dilige mulierem dilectam amico et adulteram,
and love a woman, beloved by a friend, yet an adulteress,
for so does the Lord love the sons of Israel,
et ipsi respiciunt ad deos alienos,
yet they look to strange gods,
and love the seeds of grapes.”
Et fodi eam mihi quindecim argenteis,
And I contracted her to me for fifteen silver coins,
and for a basket of barley,
and half a basket of barley.
“You will wait for me for many days.
and you will not be with a man.
But I also will wait for you.”
Quia dies multos sedebunt filii Israël sine rege,
For the sons of Israel will sit for many days without a king,
Et post hæc revertentur filii Israël,
And after this, the sons of Israel will return,
et quærent Dominum Deum suum, et David regem suum:
and they will seek the Lord their God and David their king,
et pavebunt ad Dominum, et ad bonum ejus,
and they will be terrified by the Lord and by his goodness,
